beat: Dinner flirting, divided gazes and the car conversation

lines.original: Dinner was served and all 4 were chatting busily and eating... getting to know each other... Sharmi was very naughty as her nature is... and making double meaning jokes, teasing Dhika.....
lines.local: Dinner serve hua aur chaaron khate hue baatein karke ek-doosre ko jaan rahe the. Sharmi apni aadat ke mutabik double-meaning jokes se Dhika ko chhed rahi thi.

lines.original: Dhika: so... what shall we order for desert.....
lines.local: Dhika: Dessert mein kya order karein?

lines.original: Sharmi: I could have a bite of John... she blurted teasingly, winking at Dhika and giving a naughty look at Raj and John...
lines.local: Sharmi ne Dhika ko wink aur Raj/John ko naughty look dekar kaha: Main toh John ka ek bite le sakti hoon!

lines.original: Dhika: hitting her with spoon..... don't mind it John... she is always playing like this....
lines.local: Dhika ne spoon se use maara: John, bura mat manna; yeh hamesha aise mazaak karti hai.

lines.original: John: hehe...its okay... its Raj who should be worried about...
lines.local: John: Hehe, mujhe koi problem nahi; chinta toh Raj ko honi chahiye.

lines.original: Raj: hehe.... he kept quite and didn't say anything....
lines.local: Raj: Hehe… woh chup raha, kuch nahi bola.

lines.original: They all finished their dinner and like typical men, John and Raj fought to pay the bill themselves with John ended up winning the bill..... John paid the bill and they all came out....
lines.local: Dinner ke baad John aur Raj dono bill bharna chahte the; aakhir John ne baazi maari, bill pay kiya aur sab bahar aaye.

lines.original: In a few minutes John and Dhika were in their car, after saying their byes to the other couple....
lines.local: Kuch minutes baad doosre couple ko bye bolkar John aur Dhika apni car mein the.

lines.original: John: Sharmi is sure as hell naughty like you said....
lines.local: John: Sharmi sach mein utni hi naughty hai jitna tum batati thi.

lines.original: Dhika: hehe... you didn't mind... with scanning her from top to bottom... and she couldn't stop flirting with you... devil
lines.local: Dhika: Hehe, tumne toh use sar se paon tak scan karne mein koi problem nahi samjhi, aur woh bhi tumse flirting nahi rok rahi thi, devil!

lines.original: John: what.... she was hot and nothing wrong in admiring someone....hehe
lines.local: John: Kya? Woh hot hai; kisi ko admire karne mein kya galat hai? Hehe.

lines.original: Dhika: hitting his hand... with your wife next to you... no shame at all... saw how polite and good Raj was....
lines.local: Dhika uske haath par maarte hue: Wife paas mein hai, phir bhi sharam nahi! Dekho Raj kitna polite aur accha tha.

lines.original: John: hehe... I am sure...
lines.local: John: Hehe, mujhe poora yakeen hai…

lines.original: Dhika: what ??? what do you mean....
lines.local: Dhika: Kya? Iska matlab?

lines.original: John: do you think anyone could stop looking at this beauty.... he pinched her hips over the dress..
lines.local: John uski dress ke upar se hips pinch karte hue: Itni khoobsurati ko dekhne se bhala koi kaise rukega?

lines.original: Dhika: oi..... don't .... she hit his hands again...
lines.local: Dhika: Oi, mat karo! Usne phir uska haath maara.

lines.original: John: Oh Raj was admiring you just as much as me looking at Sharmi.... hehe
lines.local: John: Raj bhi tumhe utna hi admire kar raha tha jitna main Sharmi ko kar raha tha, hehe.

lines.original: Dhika: noooo.... I didn't see
lines.local: Dhika: Nahiii, maine toh nahi dekha.

lines.original: John: hehe... you never see anything...
lines.local: John: Hehe, tumhe toh kabhi kuch dikhta hi nahi.

lines.original: They teased each other all the way to the home.....
lines.local: Ghar tak dono ek-doosre ko chhedte rahe.
